task: 12.3 ranking evaluation set for the NOVA jobs agent

files.cases.jsonl: 200 rows: case_id, candidate, listing. No labels.
files.labels.jsonl: 200 rows: case_id, label (relevant | not_relevant), note. The human label file.
files.ranking_quality.json: Generated by `npm run score` in nova/services/jobs-service. Carries the measured precision@50. Without the set it carries no measured claim.

provenance: Labels authored by hand on 2026-11-13 by the implementing model working as the labeler of record. Each label is a recruiter-style judgment call, not a restatement of the ranker rules. Some labels deliberately disagree with a naive heuristic: je048 and je186 pass every filter but are not relevant because the remote mode contradicts the stated onsite preference; je012 has a partial skill overlap and is relevant; je075 has a JVM overlap and is not relevant (legacy SOAP only).

candidate_schema.candidate_id: stable id, 10 archetypes c1 to c10, 20 listings each
candidate_schema.work_auth: region codes the candidate may work in: IN, GLOBAL
candidate_schema.salary_min: floor per region. IN rows use LPA, GLOBAL rows use USD thousands

listing_schema.listing_id: equals case_id, so ranking joins labels by listing_id
listing_schema.salary_max: cap in the region unit, or null

hard_filter_semantics: work_auth: clearance always fails. sponsorship fails unless candidate work_auth holds the listing region token.
place: onsite and hybrid require the same city, case-insensitive. remote always passes.
experience: fails when listing years exceed candidate years.
role: fails when the listing role is not in candidate roles.
salary: fails when a present salary_max is below the candidate floor for the region. null never filters.

scoring_factors.skills: share of listing skill tokens the candidate holds
scoring_factors.experience: candidate years over listing years, capped at one
scoring_factors.place: exact preference match one, remote-with-any-preference 0.7, else 0.3
scoring_factors.salary: headroom (cap minus floor) over cap, clamped to 0..1; missing values sit at 0.5

metric.name: precision_at_50
metric.definition: share of relevant labels among the 50 highest-scored cases, ties broken by case_id
metric.rerank: a second number measures the same order after the optional embedding rerank. The rerank reorders filter survivors only.

join_semantics: A label whose case is missing fails the run.
A case without a label fails the run.
The set must hold exactly 200 cases and 200 labels. Any other count fails the run.
usage_rules: No ranking quality claim may cite a number that is not in ranking_quality.json.
ranking_quality.json carries the measured key only when the set was scored.
